input.summary: Add exclusive New York County venue to the New York choice-of-law clause
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law works for us, but the clause names no forum, so we have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County to match our playbook position. We are happy to make venue non-exclusive if that helps.

ops.oldText: without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
ops.newText: without regard for its conflict of laws provisions, and each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.
